title: metrosideros pumila
intro: Metrosideros pumila, commonly known as the New Zealand rata or Pōhutukawa, is a flowering plant native to New Zealand. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and reducing fever. The therapeutic actions of Metrosideros pumila include antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties, making it useful in treating infections and promoting tissue repair. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
